fields.description: Issue dated April 28, 1928, featuring editorials and satirical commentary on Miami’s preparations for the forthcoming Shrine convention, including concerns about civic spending, hospitality, policing, traffic hazards on Biscayne Boulevard, and local conditions during the event. Includes discussion of the opening and promotion of the Tamiami Trail and transportation matters, prohibition-era liquor and enforcement themes, local politics and elections, and business/financial news including bank reorganization coverage. Contains poems, humor columns, and substantial advertising and event notices.
